question: Which of the following statements about fluconazole is most accurate?

options.opa: It is highly effective in the treatment of aspergillosis
options.opb: It does not penetrate the blood-brain barrier
options.opc: Its oral bioavailability is less than that of ketoconazole

analysis: Fluconazole is an antifungal medication that is commonly used to treat various fungal infections. It is known for its ability to penetrate the blood-brain barrier, making it effective in treating fungal infections of the central nervous system. Fluconazole has good oral bioavailability, similar to that of ketoconazole. It inhibits the enzyme lanosterol 14-alpha-demethylase, which is involved in the synthesis of ergosterol in fungal cell membranes.
